subject: Renewal discussion: commit top-up & throughput rebalance for Ava Solutions
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avasolutions.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + option to increase monthly commit and throughput

Hi Jordan,

Quick note as we approach your annual renewal on 2026-08-15 — congrats on the successful pilot earlier this year. Usage has been trending up, and I wanted to outline options so we don't get caught short on rate limits / burst capacity when teams ramp.

Two paths we normally recommend:
- Top-up monthly commit (reduces per-token unit)
- Rebalance tiers to increase sustained rate limits and add a burst buffer (short-term higher QPS)

If Ava is looking at a predictable production ramp, I can draft a brief amendment that bumps the commit and adjusts rate limits, plus a scheduling note for prorated billing. Would you be open to a 30-minute sync later this week to confirm expected monthly tokens and peak QPS?

Attaching a one-pager I use to capture commit/throughput requests (commit_summary.xlsx) — fill out the green column if useful.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: commit_summary.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avasolutions.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + option to increase monthly commit and throughput

Karthik,

Thanks for the heads up. We are planning to increase usage across two products effective Sept 1. Rough target: ~3x our current monthly commit and a sustained QPS increase from 150 to 500 with a short burst capacity up to 1,200 for batch jobs.

We also need confirmation on the following before we sign an amendment:
- Clear per-token pricing at the new commit tier
- Confirmed rate limits per-route and global rate limit behavior when burst is active
- Any change to data retention / audit logging (compliance team asked)

If you can send a preliminary pricing sheet and example amendment language we can review with procurement. I can do a 30-min call Thu afternoon (PDT).

Jordan Lee
Director of Platform Engineering
Ava Solutions
jordan.lee@avasolutions.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal window + option to increase monthly commit and throughput

Looping in Marissa (AM) and Vanessa (Billing) to put numbers together + surface any contractual language. Jordan — Marissa will propose commit levels and pricing; Vanessa will confirm proration and billing timing.

We filled in the highest expected values from your note into the attached commit_summary.xlsx (tab: requested_topup). Marissa — Jordan wants 3x monthly commit + sustained 500 QPS / burst 1,200. Also flag compliance question about audit logs.

Thanks team,
Karthik

Attachment: commit_summary.xlsx (updated, 18KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avasolutions.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + option to increase monthly commit and throughput

Jordan — thanks, we ran numbers with product and engineering. Summary (proposal):

- Term: 12 months (amendment to current MSA), effective 2026-09-01
- Monthly committed tokens: Increase from current 1.2B -> 3.6B (3x)
- Unit price: current $0.0007/token -> $0.00058/token at new commit (volume-discounted tier)
- Sustained rate limit: 500 QPS globally; per-route soft limit 350 QPS with automatic smoothing
- Burst overlay: 1,200 QPS for up to 5 minutes per hour; excess burst billed at a reduced overage rate
- Compliance: no change to default data retention; audit logs can be exported via our Console (we'll add 12 months retention for Ava at no additional infra cost)

I've attached a redline of pricing and the two-paragraph amendment language we usually use. If that looks good, Vanessa will send the amendment and catch the prorated first invoice (Sept billing cycle).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 646-555-0198

Attachment: redwood_pricing_terms_v2.pdf (pdf, 54KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avasolutions.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + option to increase monthly commit and throughput — billing details

Jordan — a few quick billing notes so procurement can plan: 

1) Proration: Since your current period ends 2026-08-15, if we switch to the new commit effective 2026-09-01 we will issue a one-time prorated invoice for the difference covering 2026-08-16 -> 2026-08-31 based on the new unit price.
2) Payment terms: Net 30 as per your MSA; we can accept PO + payment or wire.
3) Overages & burst: Any sustained usage above the committed tokens in a given month will be billed as overage at $0.00075/token. Burst usage within the 5-minute window above the burst threshold is billed at $0.00065/token.
4) Billing contact & PO: Please send PO to finance@avasolutions.com with the header: RW-AVA-2026-08. We'll attach the amendment for signature (DocuSign).

Estimated monthly invoice example at new commit: 3.6B tokens * $0.00058 = $2,088,000/month. (We know procurement likes to see the line math; full table attached.)

Deal ID: RW-AVA-2026-08
I will prepare the amendment and upload to DocuSign — ETA: Mon 08/03.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: ava_docusign_amendment.docx (docx, 25KB)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@avasolutions.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + option to increase monthly commit and throughput

Team — thanks for the clear breakdown. Ava will move forward with the 3.6B monthly commit and the 500 QPS sustained / 1,200 burst overlay. Procurement will send the PO next week; please route the DocuSign amendment to me (jordan.lee@avasolutions.com) and to finance@avasolutions.com.

We also accept the proposed audit log retention change — please include the 12-month export configuration in the amendment.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Karthik — let's keep the Thu sync as a check-in; I may cancel if procurement is ready sooner.

Jordan
